text:
emma_sales: Quick help — large prospect wants a deferred annual prepay with milestone-based quarterly invoicing. Need deal-desk + finance signoff. Details below.

emma_sales: Summary: 3yr commit, $1.2M ARR (yearly), customer wants 70% prepay Year1, remaining 30% invoiced across 3 quarters tied to POC/milestone acceptance. Also asking for a multi-year discount. They insist on Net90 for the post-prepay invoices.

mike_deals: @olivia_finance @raj_legal can we do 70% upfront + Net90 on remainder? any immediate red flags? :eyes:

olivia_finance: High-level finance view: upfront is fine but 70% for a new enterprise is outside our preferred limits. Accounting prefers <=60% prepay for new customers due to revenue recognition (ASC606) and refund/rollback handling. Net90 is risky for receivables. Need credit-check and proof of funds.

olivia_finance: Also need billing country (for VAT/withholding), GL mapping, and PO requirements. If customer requires Net90, we need stronger credit/guarantor or escrow.

emma_sales: Customer is US-based (Delaware corp), billing address provided in the attachment. They're asking 70% because they want the discounted price in year1. Commit is $3.6M total over 3 years (1.2M/yr). Year2/3 step-down pricing: 10% off year1 price for year2, 5% off for year3.

raj_legal: Legal notes: milestone-based invoice schedule is acceptable with clear acceptance criteria in SOW. Net90 on the post-prepay tranche is a legal/credit risk. Recommend Net30 or require escrow/letter of credit for Net90. Also need to add: breach/termination pro rata refund mechanics, IP/data clauses, and SOC2/audit rights if they request. Discounts >7% require GC sign-off per pricing policy.

ana_solutions: For the POC/milestone definition — suggest concrete criteria:
- Milestone A (quarter 1): 99% availability over a 14-day window + pass of 200 evaluation prompts (baseline test set) with no regression >3% compared to control.
- Milestone B (quarter 2): latency SLA met for 95th percentile at target load.
We can instrument with our eval harness and provide logs for acceptance. Ops can run a canary deployment for validation.

billing-bot: Auto-generated invoice schedule preview:
```
Invoice 1 (Upfront): 70% of Year1 = $840,000 — Due on signature
Invoice 2 (Q1): 10% of Year1 = $120,000 — Due Net90 after milestone acceptance
Invoice 3 (Q2): 10% of Year1 = $120,000 — Due Net90 after milestone acceptance
Invoice 4 (Q3): 10% of Year1 = $120,000 — Due Net90 after milestone acceptance
Total Year1 billed = $1,200,000
```

mike_deals: Counter-proposal from sales: 60% upfront, 40% spread over 4 quarters (10%/quarter) with Net30 after each milestone acceptance, and multi-year discount capped at 8%. This reduces cash/credit risk and gets them most of the upfront they want. @olivia @raj thoughts?

olivia_finance: I can approve conceptually if finance + legal agree to 60/40 and discount <=8%. Conditions: pass credit check, ACH/wire only (no checks), signed credit application, our revenue ops to set recognition schedule. I'll flag to Deal Desk to formalize.

raj_legal: Acceptable if SOW includes explicit acceptance tests and refund mechanics. For Net90 request we should insist on escrow or a letter of credit; otherwise Net30 for post-tranche invoices. I'll draft the SOW language and the required clause for discounts >7%.

emma_sales: Thanks. I'll update SOW to the 60/40 split and 8% discount cap, include milestone tests from @ana_solutions, and send to customer EOD tomorrow. Escalating to Deal Desk for final pricing approval.

mike_deals: tagging @olivia_finance to confirm Deal Desk ok to proceed once legal sends SOW language. :thumbsup:

olivia_finance: Noted — will queue in Deal Desk. Finance needs the signed credit app before countersignature.

emma_sales: Perfect, I'll request credit app now. Will update thread with the redline when ready.

raj_legal: I'll share draft SOW in this thread when done. Expect 24-36h.

mike_deals: Great teamwork — keep me posted.

emma_sales: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
